title: Eagle Peak Shooting Range
specs: Pistol ranges with 7, 15, and 25-yard positions and 18 covered stations
Rifle ranges with 50, 100, 200, and 300-yard positions and 28 covered stations
Shotgun clay pigeon throwers with 8 throwers, 3 covered
Children under 5 are not permitted on the range

blurb: Guests watch a 5-minute safety video and agree to range rules to become lifetime range card holders. The range offers pistol stations at 7, 15, and 25 yards, rifle stations at 50, 100, 200, and 300 yards with complimentary golf cart use, and shotgun clay pigeon throwers. Rentals, ammunition, and gunsmith services are available on site.
